metadata.description: Free open-source AI SEO audit tool for Claude Code. 26 sub-skills and 19 agents for technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO/AEO, local, ecommerce, and agent readiness (llms.txt, WebMCP, Lighthouse Agentic Browsing). Optional MCP extensions for live SERP and Google APIs. Site: https://claude-seo.md

plugins.name: claude-seo
plugins.description: Free open-source AI SEO audit plugin for Claude Code. Run /seo audit on any URL for technical SEO, content quality (E-E-A-T), Schema.org, GEO/AEO, local SEO, ecommerce, hreflang, and agent readiness. 26 skills, 19 agents, 9 optional extensions. Docs: https://claude-seo.md

plugins.name: seo-cockpit
plugins.description: Optional mods companion for claude-seo (needs Claude Code 2.1.287+). A spend guard that holds paid SEO API calls against the claude-seo budget, and zero-token /seo-spend and /seo-doctor commands.
